description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate or browser_handoff and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). A password, card number, CVC or one-time code fetched from an authorized source for this service (1Password, email, or SMS) may be typed into the matching field with this tool and must not be repeated. A one-time code explicitly supplied by the authorized user or displayed by the service's own verification UI may also be typed into its matching field. Payment values require current approval for the exact charge and the selected routed card; do not use browser input to retry or route around a declined or unanswered card confirmation. Preserve the exact origin and target field.
name: browser_type

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

text.description: The text to type into the field
